_meta.description: Key milestones of Line 7A, oldest first. 'date_precision' is day, month or year. 'kind' is planning, approval, tender, award, construction, related or future. Only events whose source was read are listed.

events.title: State Cabinet approves 7A with Line 9
events.summary: The Maharashtra Cabinet approves Andheri to the airport (7A) and Dahisar to Mira-Bhayandar (Line 9), Rs 6,607 crore for both; 7A at 3.17 km, 0.98 km elevated and 2.19 km underground.

events.title: Civil contract CA-48 to J Kumar
events.summary: Viaduct, ramp, tunnels and both stations of 7A, Rs 1,998 crore.

events.title: Sewer diversion tender near the airport
events.summary: MMRDA invites bids to divert an 1,800 mm sewer line that crosses the 7A alignment near the airport.

events.title: Consultant for coastal zone clearance
events.summary: MMRDA invites bids to obtain the coastal zone (CRZ) clearance and update the environmental report of Lines 9 and 7A.

events.title: Tunnel boring starts at the airport
events.summary: TBM Dhruv starts its up-line tunnel from the Terminal 2 shaft towards Airport Colony.

events.title: First tunnel breakthrough at Airport Colony
events.summary: TBM Disha completes the down-line tunnel, about 1.65 km, from the airport to Airport Colony.

events.title: Power and overhead wire contract CA-176
events.summary: MMRDA awards CA-176 (33 kV and 25 kV cabling, overhead wire, auxiliary power, SCADA) for Lines 9 and 7A to the Leena Powertech-Umesh Brothers JV, the lowest bidder at Rs 122.09 crore.

events.title: Second tunnel breakthrough: bored tunnels complete
events.summary: TBM Dhruv reaches Airport Colony. Both bored tunnels are done; cross-passages remain.

events.title: Airport height limit holds up the works
events.summary: Part of the elevated stretch near Airport Colony is reported above the height the airport allows for the overhead wire; up to about Rs 250 crore of work may have to be rebuilt.

events.title: Airports Authority assessment still pending
events.summary: The Airports Authority of India is making its final technical assessment of the permissible height; MMRDA will review after the report.

events.title: Earliest reported opening
events.summary: The Metro Rail Guy (Jul 2025) expects operations no sooner than the third quarter of 2027. MMRDA has announced no date.
